Select exact IC50 activity rows for compounds tested against human Aromatase (CHEMBL1978) that have canonical SMILES and a PubMed ID or DOI. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, then to assays on assay_id, then to target_dictionary on tid. Filter by target_chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1978' and standard_type = 'IC50' and standard_relation = '='. Require canonical_smiles to be present via INNER JOIN to compound_structures. Retrieve pubmed_id_or_doi via LEFT JOIN docs on assays.doc_id, preferring pubmed_id when available. Retrieve compound_key via LEFT JOIN compound_records on activities.record_id. Keep all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism.
